mapper.sql: ra.route_id, ra.visit_order, ra.poi_id, ra.visit_time, ra.recommended_duration, ra.notes, a.parent_poi_id, a.name, a.address, a.location, a.pcode, a.pname, a.citycode, a.cityname, a.adcode, a.adname, a.type, a.typecode, a.distance, a.created_at as attraction_created_at, a.updated_at as attraction_updated_at, ra.created_at as route_created_at
mapper.insert: insert into route_attractions (route_id, visit_order, poi_id, visit_time, recommended_duration, notes, parent_poi_id, name, address, location, pcode, pname, citycode, cityname, adcode, adname, type, typecode, distance, attraction_created_at, attraction_updated_at) values (#{routeId}, #{visitOrder}, #{poiId}, #{visitTime}, #{recommendedDuration}, #{notes}, #{parentPoiId}, #{name}, #{address}, #{location}, #{pcode}, #{pname}, #{citycode}, #{cityname}, #{adcode}, #{adname}, #{type}, #{typecode}, #{distance}, #{attractionCreatedAt}, #{attractionUpdatedAt})
mapper.select: select from route_attractions order by route_id asc, visit_order asc
